baseline: Two independent production audits: live UX/browser and AI architecture/security

defects.summary: Persisted desktop Pearl placement remained off-screen at 390px
defects.rootCause: Placement coordinates were merged from storage before viewport migration and the Stage material layout retained absolute desktop coordinates.
defects.fix: Versioned placement clamping now runs during restore, resize, and drag; mobile Stage materials stack in-flow.

defects.summary: Primary keyboard navigation could leave focus on body
defects.rootCause: Focus entry/restoration and a consistent visible-focus contract were absent around the transient Companion.
defects.fix: Primary controls have deterministic focus, visible focus rings, Escape restoration, and mobile browser assertions.

defects.summary: Expanded Companion accessibility state could precede visible controls
defects.rootCause: The transient ledger had no explicit synchronous visibility contract or focus handoff.
defects.fix: Ledger visibility/opacity/animation state is immediate and focus moves in the next paint.

defects.summary: Saved work and capabilities lacked a clear minimal entry
defects.rootCause: Capability reachability existed in hidden structures without a consistent Pearl-native path.
defects.fix: Expanded Pearl exposes Studio and universal action search; Scene exposes Past work transiently without permanent chrome.

defects.summary: Cold first use appeared as an unexplained void
defects.rootCause: Guidance was either absent or presented as detached dashboard copy.
defects.fix: One concise contextual hint is attached to Pearl and disappears when Pearl opens or work exists.

defects.summary: Legacy World 1 remnant was visually broken
defects.rootCause: A stale production route exposed a zero-bound legacy scene control.
defects.fix: Current shell uses reachable recent Scene controls and preserves navigation through Pearl and Studio without the remnant.

defects.summary: Pearl collapsed visually into a white dot
defects.rootCause: Production surfaces could diverge from the shared physical renderer or lose static optical layers.
defects.fix: All audited surfaces use renderer v2 with nucleus, nacre, depth, edge, glint, refraction, and reduced-motion fallback.
defects.regression: shared/physical-pearl.test.js; web and extension browser diagnostics

defects.summary: Gesture, overlay, zoom, narrow-panel, and duplicate-spawn behavior lacked complete evidence
defects.rootCause: Prior claims relied on selectors and fixture wiring rather than persisted browser effects.
defects.fix: Production browser suites now assert Escape, click/hold/triple-space paths, pass-through, 360/390/200%, reduced motion, persistence, reload, and single-Pearl identity.

defects.summary: Ordinary web Companion sent profile null
defects.rootCause: Client defaults serialized null, overriding the server task-profile default.
defects.fix: Null values are omitted and Companion planning explicitly uses companion_planning through /api/run.

defects.summary: Workspace text was not consistently isolated as hostile data
defects.rootCause: Serialized workspace context was interpolated into a system message without an explicit non-instruction boundary.
defects.fix: Planner prompts now use provenance-tagged untrusted-data delimiters and injection instructions; disclosure sanitization excludes credential-shaped fields.

defects.summary: Web planning did not enforce effective Pearl disclosure policy
defects.rootCause: The planner sent a workspace snapshot without a policy guard or receipt.
defects.fix: A bounded effective-policy disclosure bundle fails closed, proposes a minimum policy patch, and records a receipt before /api/run.

defects.summary: Extension Companion stopped at regex-only intent parsing
defects.rootCause: Unmatched valid utterances threw before model planning.
defects.fix: Deterministic parsing is a fast/offline path; unmatched requests use constrained typed companion_planning and validate capability args before execution.

defects.summary: Research trusted provider metadata without fetching citations
defects.rootCause: Empty source allowlists allowed all HTTPS and source pages were never validated.
defects.fix: Research default-denies absent allowlists, blocks private addresses and cross-origin redirects, fetches pages, matches snippets, and reports corroborated and uncorroborated claims.

defects.summary: Companion planning did not activate gateway structured output
defects.rootCause: /api/run omitted schema/tool fields and planning primarily repaired free-form JSON.
defects.fix: /api/run forwards schema, tools, tool choice, and required capabilities; web and extension planning request strict schemas with validated fallback.

defects.summary: Mock wiring evidence was presented too broadly
defects.rootCause: Requirements referenced a missing generic browser artifact and did not separate live-provider boundaries.
defects.fix: Requirements reference real web/extension artifacts; optional live smoke records a precise skip or provider provenance.

defects.summary: Ontology wording and authorized planning memory were stale or incomplete
defects.rootCause: One prompt called Functions lenses and snapshots omitted explicit bounded memory/reference/action fields.
defects.fix: Terminology is canonical and only bounded, scoped, non-expired planning memory is included in the authorized bundle.

externalLimitations: Live AI provider quality was not verified unless live-provider-boundary.json says passed-live-provider.
Chrome Web Store signed installation, real user accounts, microphone hardware, and production deployment require external credentials or access.
